name: GovTreasurer
claim_model: Stakers self-withdraw via withdraw(2,amount) (works). emergencyWithdraw(2) is broken and destructive: it zeroes user.amount BEFORE transferring, so a mined call would pay 0 and destroy the claim.
evidence: verified source GovTreasurer; pool 2 = WETH; contract WETH balance 18997361966058381030 (18.997361966)
userInfo(2,*) for 86 WETH counterparties: 21 non-zero stakers, sum=18.99736196605838 == contract WETH balance exactly
cast call --from 0xBd786740... withdraw(2,1e18) -> success (0x); cast call --from same emergencyWithdraw(2) -> success but source transfers user.amount after setting it to 0 => 0 wei paid
updatePool calls safeGDAOTransfer(address(this),reward) = self-transfer no-op; GDAO rewards accounted but not reserved
notes: DO NOT call emergencyWithdraw(2): a mined call permanently forfeits the position (funds stay in contract, claim wiped). Only withdraw(2,amount) is safe. No E-U (non-staker cannot call for another user; userInfo keyed by msg.sender).
